title: Ep 38 — Anthropic's Nasdaq Whisper Gets a Date, and the AI Dubbing Tool That Took Three Years to Earn Real Money
description: Anthropic's stock-market rumours firm up with a named exchange and a rough date, GitHub hands developers a cost-versus-quality dial for Copilot, and Claude Code ships real per-command sandboxing in a two-day patch train. Plus a deep dive on Stripe-verified AI dubbing tool VideoDubber.ai's honest three-year grind to modest revenue, and updates for PlayFundWin, LeaguePages and EV-Partnerships including the sports-venue charging gap's twenty-first straight episode and an eight-day countdown on the DCMS good-causes consultation.
